Prompt

Create a membership comparison page for a fitness center or gym. Include these sections:

1. HERO SECTION
- Headline: "Find Your Perfect Membership"
- Subheadline: "Flexible plans to fit your fitness goals and lifestyle"
- Monthly/Annual toggle (annual saves 20%)
- Current promotion banner: "Join today, get your first month FREE"

2. MEMBERSHIP CARDS (3-4 tiers)

BASIC - $29/month ($24/mo annually)
"Perfect for getting started"
- Gym access (6am - 10pm)
- Cardio equipment
- Weight machines
- Locker room access
- Free parking
CTA: "Start Basic" (outline button)

STANDARD - $49/month ($39/mo annually)
"Most Popular" badge
"Our best value for regular gym-goers"
- Everything in Basic
- 24/7 access
- Free weights area
- 5 group classes/month
- Fitness assessment
- Mobile app access
CTA: "Start Standard" (primary button, highlighted)

PREMIUM - $79/month ($65/mo annually)
"For serious fitness enthusiasts"
- Everything in Standard
- Unlimited classes
- Pool & sauna access
- 2 PT sessions/month
- Towel service
- Guest passes (2/month)
- Priority class booking
CTA: "Start Premium" (outline button)

ELITE - $149/month ($125/mo annually)
"The ultimate fitness experience"
- Everything in Premium
- Unlimited PT sessions
- Spa treatments (2/month)
- Nutrition coaching
- Recovery suite access
- Exclusive member events
- No contract, cancel anytime
CTA: "Start Elite" (outline button)

3. DETAILED COMPARISON TABLE
Full feature matrix:

| Feature | Basic | Standard | Premium | Elite |
|---------|-------|----------|---------|-------|
| Gym Hours | 6am-10pm | 24/7 | 24/7 | 24/7 |
| Cardio Equipment | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Weight Machines | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Free Weights | - | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Group Classes | - | 5/month | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Pool & Sauna | - | - | ✓ | ✓ |
| Personal Training | - | - | 2/month | Unlimited |
| Towel Service | - | - | ✓ | ✓ |
| Guest Passes | - | - | 2/month | 4/month |
| Spa Access | - | - | - | ✓ |
| Nutrition Coach | - | - | - | ✓ |

Sticky header on scroll showing plan names and prices

4. CLASS INCLUSION DETAILS
- List of included classes by tier
- Class schedule preview
- "View Full Schedule" link
- Popular classes highlighted

5. FACILITY ACCESS
Visual grid showing:
- Which areas each tier can access
- Photos of each facility area
- Icons for quick scanning

6. ADD-ONS SECTION
"Enhance any membership:"
- Personal Training Pack (4 sessions): $150
- Nutrition Consultation: $75
- Additional Guest Passes (5-pack): $25
- Locker Rental: $15/month
- Towel Service (for Basic/Standard): $10/month

7. TESTIMONIALS BY TIER
Real member quotes:
- Basic member: "Great for my lunch workouts"
- Premium member: "The classes changed everything"
- Elite member: "Worth every penny for the PT"

8. FAQ SECTION
- "Can I upgrade my membership?"
- "Is there a joining fee?"
- "What's the contract length?"
- "Can I freeze my membership?"
- "Do you offer student/senior discounts?"
- "Can I try before I join?"

9. SPECIAL OFFERS
- Student discount: 20% off
- Senior discount: 15% off
- Corporate rates available
- Family bundles
- Military/First responder discount

10. GUARANTEE SECTION
- "30-Day Money Back Guarantee"
- "No hidden fees, ever"
- "Freeze anytime for up to 3 months"
- "Easy cancellation process"

11. SIGN-UP FLOW PREVIEW
What to expect:
- Step 1: Choose your plan
- Step 2: Pick your start date
- Step 3: Complete payment
- Step 4: Schedule orientation

12. LOCATION SELECTOR
If multiple locations:
- "Select your home gym"
- Map with locations
- Access to all locations included (by tier)

13. FINAL CTA
- "Still not sure? Get a free day pass"
- "Schedule a tour"
- "Talk to a membership advisor"
- Phone number and chat option

Design: Clean comparison layout. Highlight recommended tier. Sticky "Join Now" bar on mobile. Checkmarks and X's for features. Trust badges (ratings, awards). Energetic color accents.
